msg: DESIGN TARGET (blocks.md B7, design 0.65 mA); REQUIREMENTS Q10 caps the board at 10 mA. Worst corner: +5 % rail, full scale. Measured 529 uA. HONEST SCOPE: the two IQ terms (AD8226 325 uA typ / 400 uA max, OPA2333 17 uA/channel typ / 25 max, both DATASHEET) are model cards and cannot fail; what is really measured here is the network current - divider, feedback leg, REF pin and load.
Sanity floor: the two ICs' own typical quiescent current already totals 359 uA (DATASHEET), so anything below that means the model is not drawing what the parts draw.
DESIGN TARGET. R2/R3 divider node at the +5 % rail: 3.465*10.0k/131k = 0.2645 V, window +-5 %. The measured divider-ratio check. MUTATION-VERIFIED: R2 121k->12.1k reads 1.568 V.
DESIGN TARGET. R4/R5 feedback leg at full scale: (3.047-0.252)/34.9k = 80.1 uA. MUTATION-VERIFIED: R2 121k->12.1k reads 53.9 uA.
REQUIREMENTS Q8 (load > 100 kohm). J2 load current at full scale: 3.047/100k = 30.5 uA.
